pages.title: Thylacine
pages.text: The thylacine ($(o)Thylacinus cynocephalus$()), also known as the Tasmanian tiger or Tasmanian wolf, is an extinct carnivorous marsupial from Australia, Tasmania and New Guinea.$(br2)It vanished from mainland Australia thousands of years ago, and the last known individual died in Hobart Zoo in 1936.$(br2)Though dog-like in shape, it was not a canid. Both sexes had a pouch, and dark stripes ran across its lower back.
